-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- GET REVENUE: B2C (LEAF + CINNA) vs B2B (JTL-Wawi + L-/C-)
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

SELECT
  -- B2C: Umsatz aus Shops LEAF Shopify + CINNA Shopify nach Rabatt
  CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(
    CASE WHEN sh.cName IN ('LEAF Shopify', 'CINNA Shopify')
         THEN pos.fVkNetto * (1 - pos.fRabatt / 100.0) * pos.nAnzahl
         ELSE 0 END
  ), 0), 2) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS Umsatz_B2C,

  -- B2B: Umsatz JTL-Wawi mit Artikeln L- oder C- nach Rabatt
  CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(
    CASE WHEN pl.cName = 'JTL-Wawi'
          AND (pos.cArtNr LIKE 'L-%' OR pos.cArtNr LIKE 'C-%')
         THEN pos.fVkNetto * (1 - pos.fRabatt / 100.0) * pos.nAnzahl
         ELSE 0 END
  ), 0), 2) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS Umsatz_B2B

FROM      tBestellung  AS b
JOIN      tPlattform   AS pl  ON b.nPlatform   = pl.nPlattform
LEFT JOIN tShop        AS sh  ON b.kShop       = sh.kShop  -- LEFT: Wawi-Aufträge haben keinen Shop
JOIN      tbestellpos  AS pos ON b.kBestellung = pos.tBestellung_kBestellung
WHERE b.dErstellt BETWEEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AND GETDATE()
  AND b.nStorno  = 0
  AND b.cType   NOT IN ('U')
  AND pos.nType  = 1;

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- GET ORDERS COUNT: B2C (LEAF + CINNA) vs B2B (JTL-Wawi + L-/C-)
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

WITH OrderClassified AS (
  SELECT
    b.kBestellung,
    sh.cName AS ShopName,
    pl.cName AS PlattformName,
    -- B2B-Flag pro Bestellung vorab berechnen (kein Aggregat nötig)
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM   tbestellpos bp
           WHERE  bp.tBestellung_kBestellung = b.kBestellung
             AND  (bp.cArtNr LIKE 'L-%' OR bp.cArtNr LIKE 'C-%')
             AND  bp.nType = 1
         )
         THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS hat_B2B_Artikel

  FROM      tBestellung AS b
  JOIN      tPlattform  AS pl ON b.nPlatform = pl.nPlattform
  LEFT JOIN tShop       AS sh ON b.kShop     = sh.kShop
  WHERE b.dErstellt BETWEEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AND GETDATE()
    AND b.nStorno  = 0
    AND b.cType   NOT IN ('U')
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN ShopName     IN ('LEAF Shopify', 'CINNA Shopify') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Anzahl_B2C,
  SUM(CASE WHEN PlattformName = 'JTL-Wawi' AND hat_B2B_Artikel = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Anzahl_B2B
FROM OrderClassified;

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- GET ORDER DETAILS: Produktstatistik B2C + B2B pro Artikel
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

SELECT
  ta.cArtNr                        AS Artikelnummer,
  MAX(tab.cName)                   AS Artikelname,

  -- B2C Spalten
  SUM(
    CASE WHEN sh.cName IN ('LEAF Shopify', 'CINNA Shopify')
         THEN CONVERT(INT, pos.nAnzahl) ELSE 0 END
  )                                AS Menge_B2C,

  CAST(ROUND(SUM(
    CASE WHEN sh.cName IN ('LEAF Shopify', 'CINNA Shopify')
         THEN pos.fVkNetto * (1 - pos.fRabatt / 100.0) * pos.nAnzahl ELSE 0 END
  ), 2) AS DECIMAL(10,2))          AS Umsatz_B2C,

  -- B2B Spalten
  SUM(
    CASE WHEN pl.cName = 'JTL-Wawi'
          AND (ta.cArtNr LIKE 'L-%' OR ta.cArtNr LIKE 'C-%')
         THEN CONVERT(INT, pos.nAnzahl) ELSE 0 END
  )                                AS Menge_B2B,

  CAST(ROUND(SUM(
    CASE WHEN pl.cName = 'JTL-Wawi'
          AND (ta.cArtNr LIKE 'L-%' OR ta.cArtNr LIKE 'C-%')
         THEN pos.fVkNetto * (1 - pos.fRabatt / 100.0) * pos.nAnzahl ELSE 0 END
  ), 2) AS DECIMAL(10,2))          AS Umsatz_B2B

FROM      tArtikel             AS ta
JOIN      tbestellpos          AS pos ON ta.cArtNr             = pos.cArtNr
JOIN      tBestellung          AS b   ON b.kBestellung         = pos.tBestellung_kBestellung
JOIN      tArtikelBeschreibung AS tab ON ta.kArtikel           = tab.kArtikel
JOIN      tPlattform           AS pl  ON b.nPlatform           = pl.nPlattform  -- korrekter Join-Key
LEFT JOIN tShop                AS sh  ON b.kShop               = sh.kShop       -- LEFT: Wawi hat keinen Shop

WHERE b.dErstellt BETWEEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AND GETDATE()
  AND b.nStorno  = 0
  AND b.cType   NOT IN ('U')
  AND pos.nType  = 1
  -- Nur B2C- oder B2B-relevante Zeilen
  AND (
       sh.cName IN ('LEAF Shopify', 'CINNA Shopify')
    OR (pl.cName = 'JTL-Wawi' AND (ta.cArtNr LIKE 'L-%' OR ta.cArtNr LIKE 'C-%'))
  )

GROUP BY ta.cArtNr, tab.cName
ORDER BY SUM(CONVERT(INT, pos.nAnzahl)) DESC;
